issues.problem: The gap list does not spell out a difference in the official loop. It replaces every parameter on densify iterations (104 of them) and the opacity parameter on reduce iterations (45). summary: No critical or major issues found. Every builder claim checked against the official code (a0db69d) holds. (1) Host: arguments/__init__.py defaults are densify_grad_threshold 0.00067, the abs-gradient accumulator (xyz_gradient_accum_abs) and AbsGS reduce_opacity, which is the 'Ours (AbsGS)' row in exp. Sec. 4.1. Supp. tab:mip_psnr/ssim/lpips report that row per scene: garden 27.82/0.876/0.089, counter 29.50/0.918/0.172, and paper_results.json matches. (2) Residual split: matches densify_residual_split/adjust_gaussian exactly. That covers the moments, every selected Gaussian being split with no clone or size prune, the prune < 0.005 after the split, and the stats reset. Selection uses abs grad / denom with radii>0 counts and the NDC factor W/2, H/2 at the render size. (3) Schedule: an independent run gives stats 501..11999 except 2501-2999 and 6001-6499, and 104 densify events from 800 to 11900. First densify steps for k=1..9 are 800/1400/2000/3000/4000/5000/6000/8400/10200; k reaches 7 at 5998, inside stage 2, as in the literal code. Here k is the global substage (L*K=9) and Gaussian levels start at 0, so late-stage thresholds go down to tau/8 for level-0 Gaussians. Renders run at 1/4 for 1..2500, 1/2 for 2501..6000, then full. Opacity reduction runs 2500..24500 (45x) with prune-first from 12000. (4) The torch pyrDown differs from cv2 by at most 1.79e-7 on a real garden image (840x1297 -> 210x325). (5) LRs: means 1.28e-4 x camera extent (runtime camera_extent = 3DGS radius). initial_lr is read after density.initialize, so the 0.01^(t/T) decay equals the official 1.28e-4 -> 1.28e-6 with no delay. SH 0.002 and shN /20, opacity 0.04, scaling 0.006, rotation 0.001. D-SSIM uses an 11x11 Gaussian window with zero padding 5. pytest: 8 passed. The smoke explanation holds: the default 2k run never leaves the 1/4 stage. The compressed-schedule result of 22.60 vs 23.05 says little about 30k quality. Remaining: three minor issues (probe coverage of grad normalisation and LRs; undocumented skipped-Adam-step and off-by-one schedule differences).
